subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and should it be named after the reported `ignoreFileContent` key or follow an existing `includeAttachments`-style channel policy?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented Feishu config contract, and adding it changes channel media ingestion behavior and configuration surface.

options.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu media-ingestion option that defaults to current download behavior and switches inbound files to placeholder-only context when disabled.

options.title: Use A Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Route Feishu through a broader channel attachment policy if maintainers want one canonical setting across channels.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Document that Feishu supports only media size limits today and does not offer an attachment-content ignore switch.

recommendation.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu media-ingestion option that defaults to current download behavior and switches inbound files to placeholder-only context when disabled.
